title: Defense Readiness Endorsement Authority, Committee Preview Mode & Dedicated Instructor Defense Scheduling Command Center

Display read-only Committee Preview Mode for defense panelists and secretary with zero endorsement buttons
Create a dedicated Instructor Defense Scheduling Command Center at /defense-schedule listing all teams with 1-click scheduling
Verify with targeted unit tests and full Playwright visual audits across Light/Dark modes and Desktop/Mobile viewports

Added Defense Scheduling navigation item with CalendarClock icon for instructors.

Added tests verifying Committee Preview Mode, Instructor Defense Readiness Check, and role-based action gating.
